description: Pull the text out of a PDF into an editable Word (.docx) file, with one heading per page. Fast, free, and fully in your browser.

faqs.a: Correct. Only the text is extracted. Fonts, images, tables and the original page layout are not carried over — the result is clean, editable text.
faqs.q: Does it keep the original layout and images?

faqs.a: Pages that are scanned images contain no text layer, so nothing can be extracted from them. This tool does not perform OCR.
faqs.q: Why is my scanned PDF's Word file empty?

faqs.a: Yes. The Word file is built entirely on your device; your PDF is never uploaded.

howto: Choose a PDF file to convert.
Click "Convert to Word" and wait while the text is extracted page by page.
Download the .docx file when it is ready.
Open it in Word, Google Docs or LibreOffice to edit the text.
title: PDF to Word
